bead.title: harness/claude: record model_surface cassette (no-static-fallback prerequisite)
bead.description: Record an authenticated TUI cassette at internal/harnesses/claude/testdata/model_surface/ by driving the claude CLI's /model command (or equivalent) and parsing the model list.
bead.acceptance:
1) internal/harnesses/claude/testdata/model_surface/ exists per ADR-002 schema v1.
2) The cassette reader returns a non-empty Models slice covering the current claude CLI exposure (haiku/sonnet/opus families).
3) Focused unit test asserts cassette parse + non-empty.
4) go test ./internal/harnesses/claude/... -count=1 green.
